1: // Simple Orbital Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: // The player controls a ship that orbits a planet. Press Space or click to toggle
4: // between inner (radius 80) and outer (radius 140) orbit. Asteroids spawn from the
5: // canvas edges and move toward the planet. Collision ends the game. Fuel depletes
6: // over time; when it reaches zero the game ends.
7: 
8: (() => {
9:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
10:   if (!canvas) {
11:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
12:     return;
13:   }
14:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
15:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth);
16:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight);
17: 
18:   // Game constants
19:   const PLANET_RADIUS = 30;
20:   const ORBIT_INNER = 80;
21:   const ORBIT_OUTER = 140;
22:   const SHIP_RADIUS = 8;
23:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 1.0;
24:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 2.5;
25:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
26:   const FUEL_DEPLETION_RATE = 0.02; // per frame
27: 
28:   let angle = 0; // radians
29:   let orbitRadius = ORBIT_INNER;
30:   let fuel = 100;
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let asteroids = [];
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34:   let running = true;
35: 
36:   // Helper functions
37:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
38: 
39:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
40:     // Choose a side: 0=top,1=right,2=bottom,3=left
41:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
42:     let x, y;
43:     const margin = 10;
44:     if (side === 0) { // top
45:       x = rand(margin, width - margin);
46:       y = -margin;
47:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
48:       x = width + margin;
49:       y = rand(margin, height - margin);
50:     } else if (side === 2) { // bottom
51:       x = rand(margin, width - margin);
52:       y = height + margin;
53:     } else { // left
54:       x = -margin;
55:       y = rand(margin, height - margin);
56:     }
57:     // Direction towards planet centre
58:     const dx = width / 2 - x;
59:     const dy = height / 2 - y;
60:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
61:     const speed = rand(ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED, ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED);
62:     const vx = (dx / dist) * speed;
63:     const vy = (dy / dist) * speed;
64:     const size = rand(6, 12);
65:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, size });
66:   };
67: 
68:   const update = (delta) => {
69:     if (!running) return;
70:     // Update ship angle
71:     angle += 0.03; // constant angular speed
72:     // Update fuel
73:     fuel = Math.max(0, fuel - FUEL_DEPLETION_RATE);
74:     if (fuel === 0) running = false;
75:     // Update asteroids
76:     asteroids.forEach((a) => {
77:       a.x += a.vx;
78:       a.y += a.vy;
79:     });
80:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids & increase score
81:     asteroids = asteroids.filter((a) => {
82:       const off = a.x < -20 || a.x > width + 20 || a.y < -20 || a.y > height + 20;
83:       if (off) score++;
84:       return !off;
85:     });
86:     // Collision detection
87:     const shipX = width / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.cos(angle);
88:     const shipY = height / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.sin(angle);
89:     for (const a of asteroids) {
90:       const d = Math.hypot(a.x - shipX, a.y - shipY);
91:       if (d < a.size + SHIP_RADIUS) {
92:         running = false;
93:         break;
94:       }
95:     }
96:     // Spawn new asteroids
97:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
98:       spawnAsteroid();
99:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
100:     }
101:   };
102: 
103:   const draw = () => {
104:     // Background – starfield
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
106:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
107:     // Draw stars
108:     stars.forEach(s => {
109:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
110:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
111:     });
112:     // Planet with gradient
113:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS / 2, width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS);
114:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
115:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
116:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
117:     ctx.beginPath();
118:     ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, PLANET_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:     ctx.fill();
120:     // Ship – triangle with slight glow
121:     const shipX = width / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.cos(angle);
122:     const shipY = height / 2 + orbitRadius * Math.sin(angle);
123:     ctx.save();
124:     ctx.translate(shipX, shipY);
125:     ctx.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
126:     const shipPath = new Path2D();
127:     shipPath.moveTo(0, -SHIP_RADIUS);
128:     shipPath.lineTo(SHIP_RADIUS * 0.8, SHIP_RADIUS);
129:     shipPath.lineTo(-SHIP_RADIUS * 0.8, SHIP_RADIUS);
130:     shipPath.closePath();
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
132:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
133:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
134:     ctx.fill(shipPath);
135:     ctx.restore();
136:     // Asteroids – irregular circles with gradient
137:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
138:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.size * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.size);
139:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#c55');
140:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#622');
141:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
142:       ctx.beginPath();
143:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
144:       ctx.fill();
145:     });
146:     // UI – fuel & score (unchanged)
147:     // UI – fuel & score
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(0)}%`, 10, 20);
151:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
152:     if (!running) {
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
154:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
155:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
157:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
158:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
159:     }
160:   };
161: 
162:   // Input – toggle orbit radius
163:   const toggleOrbit = () => {
164:     orbitRadius = orbitRadius === ORBIT_INNER ? ORBIT_OUTER : ORBIT_INNER;
165:   };
166:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
167:     if (e.code === 'Space') toggleOrbit();
168:   });
169:   canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleOrbit);
170: 
171:   // Main loop
172:   let lastTime = 0;
173:   const loop = (time) => {
174:     const delta = time - lastTime;
175:     lastTime = time;
176:     update(delta);
177:     draw();
178:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
179:   };
180:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181: })();
